name: Dashboard
description: Turn a spreadsheet, CSV, or dataset into an interactive, filterable dashboard.
briefPlaceholder: Describe the data and what you want to see. Paste CSV or table data directly, or point at a file in the workspace...
promptScaffold:
This job produces a DATA DASHBOARD exhibit.
- Build an interactive, filterable dashboard from the data the user provided in the brief (pasted CSV, tables, numbers) or from files referenced there.
- Layout: KPI summary cards on top, charts below (choose chart types that fit the data), and a filter bar (date range, category, text search — whichever apply).
- All charts and KPIs must recompute live when filters change.
- Use only the data provided. If the brief includes no usable data, build the full dashboard UI with an obvious paste/import panel and honest empty states — do NOT invent plausible-looking data.
- Include a small 'Data' view (sortable table) so users can verify the underlying rows.

options.label: Spreadsheet / CSV file
options.prompt: The source data is in this local file: {value} — read and parse it.

options.label: Pasted data
options.placeholder: Paste CSV or table data here...

options.label: Web page
options.prompt: The source data lives at this URL: {value} — fetch it (e.g., with curl) and extract the data.
